transcript:
Speaker A (Tara): मला वाटलं मी एकटीच आहे जिला इंग्लिश मध्ये बोलणं जमत नाही, ते पण स्ट्रेंजर्सशी. [I thought I was the only one who couldn't speak English, that too with strangers.]
Speaker B (Rajat): नाही गं, इंग्लिश बोलायची वेळ आली ना की माझं डोकं असंच ब्लँक होतं. [No, when it's time to speak English, my mind just goes blank.]
Speaker A (Tara): सेम! पण इथे बोलता बोलता आता हळूहळू कॉन्फिडन्स येतोय. [Same! But speaking here, slowly confidence is coming.]
Speaker B (Rajat): हो ना, मला पण वाटतंय. [Yes, I feel so too.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): MySivi ॲपवर १ कोटी लोकं स्पोकन इंग्लिशची प्रॅक्टिस करतात. तुम्ही पण आजच सुरू करा, ट्रायल फक्त १ रुपयात. [Over 1 crore people practice spoken English on the MySivi app. You too start today, trial for just 1 rupee.]

summary: The ad features a simulated voice call between two Marathi speakers sharing their struggles with speaking English and how the MySivi app helps build their confidence. A voiceover highlights that over 10 million people use the app for spoken English practice. It concludes with a call to action to download the app and try the premium features for just ₹1.
